title: A flat map of locally Noetherian spaces from a Gorenstein source is Gorenstein with Gorenstein target local rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a flat morphism f : X -> Y of locally Noetherian algebraic spaces over S with X Gorenstein, the morphism f is Gorenstein and every local ring O_{Y,f(x)} is Gorenstein. The retained proof states the mechanism: after translating into algebra using the chapter's lemma-gorenstein (and comparing with the proof of lemma-composition-gorenstein) the claim is Dualizing Complexes, lemma-flat-under-gorenstein. Retained author proof at lines 6662-6667.
